## WHY A FIFTH PASS
The repair-chain rule: a repair made in response to a pass owes its own pass, scoped to THAT diff, and the chain closes on the first
VALID pass that finds zero floor breaches surviving adjudication, with the denominator stated.  **Pass 4 did not close**: six of
eight fired seats said CLOSE, but the two measuring/flagship seats each built a REAL 23/23 sweep on v4 -- Opus: `M_OVFSUPONLY`
(`implemented = (PSR & MODE) != 0` at the OVERFLOW arm; a user-mode overflow ended the emulation again and no row noticed);
Opus and Fable: `M_SFRZMIS` (`if (!is_trap)` -> `if (!is_trap && vector == MISALIGNED)` on the SFRZ re-route; `error` was the
only frozen non-trap row).  Fable graded the second an L2 floor breach ({SFRZ set, non-trap} x {class} is a body-tested joint
cell of two predicates dominating the diff's tail labels) and the first clause-(e) debt; Opus the reverse.  **Both CLASSES were
closed in ONE diff** per the repair-chain amendment (two consecutive passes finding one class -> close the class, not the cell).
minimax's ONE MORE rested on SFD1 being bit 1: `m88k_psl.h` defines `M88K_PSR_SFD1 0x00000008` (bit 3), so that reading is
answered by the tree.  agy DELIBERATELY NOT FIRED (reserved for measurement).

## SETTLED PREMISES, RE-INLINED (each a QUESTION if you can check it)
1. `m88k_psl.h`: MODE 0x80000000, SFD1 0x00000008, MXM 0x00000004, IND 0x00000002, SFRZ 0x00000001.  Reset PSR 0x80000002.
2. The exception path's PSR write is ONE site, an OR-in: `m88k_stcr(cpu, cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR] | SFRZ | IND | SFD1 | MODE, ...)`
   -> post-exception PSR 0x8000000b from every pre-fault value in the table (0x9000000b for ovfc).  EPSR is written only on the
   unfrozen path (a frozen second fault keeps the first fault's EPSR; the rows expect 0x80000002 there).
3. Order inside `m88k_exception()`: switch 1 (class -> `implemented`, INFO diagnostic); the FALLBACK (`vector < 128 &&
   !implemented` -> `unimplemented ... vector=0x%03x` + every cpu stopped); THEN the SFRZ re-route (`if (PSR & SFRZ) { if (!is_trap)
   { vector = ERROR; } update_shadow_regs = false; }`); then the common path (EPSR/PSR/shadows/pc = VBR + 8*vector); then the tail switch.
4. `m88k_stcr` case PSR: stores the value verbatim (MODE-clear by stcr prints a WARNING and continues; MXM set stops the cpu; a
   byte-order flip stops the cpu).  So a handler may write SFRZ=1 / SFD1=0 / MODE=0 itself.
5. `divu`/`divu_imm`/`mulu`...: `if (PSR & SFD1) -> SFU1_PRECISE` is tested BEFORE `divisor == 0 -> ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE`
   (`cpu_m88k_instr.c` anchor `M88K_FPECR_FUNIMP`).  `prom_call` raises UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE only when MODE is clear (anchor
   `If executed from user mode, then cause an exception`).  `X(tb0)`/tb1: a user-mode trap naming a vector < 128 raises PRIVILEGE.
6. `All machines stopped.` (emul.c) is the ONLY stop emission; the probe's `stopped` is that substring and `halted` = fallback
   diagnostic AND stopped AND (for the two expected-HALT rows) the named vector.
7. The probe program: MARK, the row's words, then `br .` at CODE=0x10000; every vector entry holds `br .`; the row's handler words are
   planted at 0x40 (the DIV0 entry) followed by `br .`; breakpoint at the expected entry; `continue`; 6 s grace.

## THE CLOSURE, WRITTEN INTO THE CONTRACT (probe docstring, CONTRACT paragraph)
* {class} x {PSR.MODE at fault}: DIV0 udiv0; PRIVILEGE priv, privtb; UNIMPLEMENTED unimpl; MISALIGNED umisalign; OVERFLOW uovf.
  BOUNDS and ERROR: no user-mode route (a user tb1 naming them raises PRIVILEGE -- privtb; every handler runs supervisor).  DISCLOSED.
  Note MODE is tested by the CALLERS (`X(tb0)`, `m88k_stcr`) and never by `m88k_exception` itself, which is why one seat graded this
  axis clause-(e) rather than floor; it is closed either way.

  same divu is sfu1h's SFU1); PRIVILEGE errpriv and UNIMPLEMENTED errunimpl (the handler drops to user mode keeping SFRZ).  BOUNDS and
  ERROR: no non-trap route; the frozen TRAP is trapfrozen (is_trap exemption, own vector, shadows frozen).  DISCLOSED.
* Still disclosed, unchanged: {class} x {delay_slot} beyond DIV0 (deferred to m88kdslotshadow: the arm is known wrong, more pins are
  more re-pins); M_DELAYALWAYS; vectors 0..3's tail arms; DMT contents (the common-path zeroing) and the frozen-trap DMT defect
  (m88kexcfrozendmt); SSBR; fcr2/4/5; first-exception SFU1 (m88kexcsfu1); exact INFO (only 'not ERROR/WARNING' is pinned);
  `implemented = is_trap` at BOUNDS/ERROR (equivalent today, m88ktbnd); a user-mode fault INSIDE a frozen handler for
  MISALIGNED/OVERFLOW/DIV0 (the {MODE} x {SFRZ} x {class} triple: same re-route code path as errpriv/errunimpl, MODE untested by
  the function -- clause (e)).

"""m88kexcdeliver -- rung-3 witness AND detector: does the m88k exception core DELIVER a trap-like
exception (vector entry reached, shadow registers right, machine still running), or stop the machine?

`cpu_m88k.c`'s exception switch marks only RESET / INTERRUPT / INSTRUCTION_ACCESS / DATA_ACCESS
`implemented`; every other vector below M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START falls to a fallback that
prints `unimplemented vector=0x%03x` and sets `running = false` on EVERY guest CPU.  The vector-
specific tail switch then has a `default:` that stops THIS cpu with `internal error` -- so a fix
needs BOTH `implemented = true` AND a tail arm (the naive one-site fix was MEASURED to halt, pass 1).
Real hardware delivers VBR + 8*vector (MC88100 UM Table 6-1, mc88100.txt:8524-8538) and the guest OS

RESULT per fault row (the classifier tests the STOP channel before pc, deliberately: the naive fix
sets pc = entry and THEN stops, so pc alone cannot tell it from delivery):
  HALT       `unimplemented vector=` printed AND the machine stopped (both observed, pass 3); an
             expected-HALT row (resid50, sfu1h) must also see ITS vector named in the diagnostic
  TAILHALT   `internal error` printed and the machine stopped (the naive fix's shape)
  STOP       the machine stopped for another reason (e.g. a wrong vector base landed in zeros)
  BADREGS    the entry breakpoint fired but a shadow-register/PSR/destination assert failed, or
             (bad=level) the transcript carried an `exception <CLASS>' line: the class printed at ERROR

             r2 unchanged (0xdeadbeef)
  NOSTART    the liveness marker never ran
Controls print DONE (r2 == the expected quotient, machine running) or a failure word.

Output: one `M88KEXC_ROW=<name> RESULT=<word> ...` line per row, `M88KEXC_RESULT=<delivered>/<fault rows>`,
`M88KEXC_SELFTEST=OK|FAIL`, `M88KEXC_DONE`.  Set M88KEXC_VERBOSE=1 for transcripts.

CONTRACT (clause e): catches a class returned to the fallback (HALT) by either route (instruction rows
and the *tb trap rows); a class reaching the tail default (TAILHALT); a wrong vector SCALING (M_VEC4,

cleared carry (ovfc); a dropped IND (indclr); the debugmsg LEVEL regression to ERROR/WARNING (bad=level on any

only 'not ERROR/WARNING' -- M_LEVEL; codex, pass 3); a skipped EPSR save; a skipped supervisor switch (the user-mode rows: EPSR MODE

CODE = 0x10000
DATA = 0x20000
XIP_V = 0x2
PSR_RESET = 0x80000002          # MODE | IND (cpu_m88k.c: cr[PSR] = M88K_PSR_MODE | M88K_PSR_IND)
PSR_EXC = 0x8000000b            # MODE | SFD1 | IND | SFRZ after the common path
PSR_USER = 0x00000002           # IND only: what the user-mode rows write via stcr
PSR_FRZSUP = 0x80000003         # MODE | IND | SFRZ, SFD1 CLEAR: a frozen handler that wants its divu to raise DIV0, not SFU1
PSR_FRZUSER = 0x00000003        # IND | SFRZ, MODE CLEAR: a frozen handler dropping to user mode (PRIVILEGE / UNIMPLEMENTED routes)

def tri(sub, d, s1, s2):
    return 0xf4000000 | (d << 21) | (s1 << 16) | (sub << 8) | s2

MARK = tri(0x60, 9, 0, 10)                       # addu r9,r0,r10  -> r9 = 0x12345678 (liveness)
SELF = 0xc0000000                                # br . (disp 0)

TB1_0_R3_4 = 0xf003d804                          # tb1 0,r3,4   -- a supervisor trap naming MISALIGNED_ACCESS (4) directly
TB1_0_R3_5 = 0xf003d805                          # tb1 0,r3,5   -- naming UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE (5)
TB1_0_R3_8 = 0xf003d808                          # tb1 0,r3,8   -- naming ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE (8)
TB1_0_R3_9 = 0xf003d809                          # tb1 0,r3,9   -- naming INTEGER_OVERFLOW (9)
TB1_0_R3_6 = 0xf003d806                          # tb1 0,r3,6   -- naming PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION (6): the user-mode tb1 filter raises
                                                 #   PRIVILEGE with is_trap == 0 (cpu_m88k_instr.c X(tb0)), so privtb is NOT the trap route
TB1_0_R3_128 = 0xf003d880                        # tb1 0,r3,128 -- the first USER trap vector: delivered by the pre-existing code (entry 0x400)
TB1_0_R3_50 = 0xf003d832                         # tb1 0,r3,50  -- a RESIDUAL vector (11..113): must still HALT (negative control vs D4)
#  The four *tb rows are the TRAP ROUTE into switch 1 for the classes whose other rows arrive by INSTRUCTION
#  (is_trap == 0).  Pass-2 seats (grok, deepseek, independently) predicted `if (!is_trap) implemented = true;'
#  escapes the instruction rows for MISALIGNED/UNIMPL/DIV0/OVF; these rows are the ones that redden it (M_ISTRAP).
                         # tb1 0,r3,10  (a supervisor trap naming vector 10 = ERROR directly)
STCR_R3_CR1 = 0x80038023                         # stcr r3,cr1 (PSR)
STCR_R5_CR1 = 0x80058025                         # stcr r5,cr1 (PSR)  -- same format: 0x80000000 | S1<<16 | 0x8000 | CR<<5 | S1
STCR_R5_CR7 = 0x800580e5                         # stcr r5,cr7 (VBR)
PSR_CARRY = 0x90000002                           # MODE | C | IND: the ovfc row's pre-fault PSR (C = bit 28, UM 6.6 'carry bit unchanged')
PSR_INDCLR = 0x80000000                          # MODE only, IND CLEAR: the indclr row's pre-fault PSR -- every other row starts with IND
                                                 #   already set, so `| M88K_PSR_IND' in the exception-path PSR write was unobservable (grok, codex, pass 3)
VBR_TEST = 0x2000                                # the vbrtb row relocates the vector table here (OpenBSD relocates its own)
LDCR_R2_CR1 = 0x80404020                         # ldcr r2,cr1
PROM_CALL = 0xf400fc92                           # M88K_PROM_INSTR
BR_N_PLUS8 = 0xc4000002
BR_N_PLUS16 = 0xc4000004                         # br.n +16: delay_target (slot+8) != slot_pc+4, so SNIP and SFIP are DIFFERENT numbers                          # br.n +2 words

V_MISALIGN, V_UNIMPL, V_PRIV, V_BOUNDS, V_DIV0, V_OVF, V_ERROR = 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10
V_SFU1 = 114
V_USER0 = 128
V_RESID = 50
VECTORS = (V_MISALIGN, V_UNIMPL, V_PRIV, V_BOUNDS, V_DIV0, V_OVF, V_ERROR, V_SFU1, V_USER0, V_RESID)

# name, program words after MARK, regs, vector, fault_pc, epsr, handler words at the div0 entry (None = br .)
ROWS = [
    ("div0",     [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],               {"r3": 0x10},                    V_DIV0,     0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("ovf",      [ADD_R2_R3_R4],                {"r3": 0x7fffffff, "r4": 1},     V_OVF,      0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("misalign", [LD_R2_R3_0],                  {"r3": DATA + 1},                V_MISALIGN, 0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("bounds",   [TB1_0_R3_7],                  {"r3": 1},                       V_BOUNDS,   0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("priv",     [STCR_R3_CR1, LDCR_R2_CR1],    {"r3": PSR_USER},                V_PRIV,     0x10008, PSR_USER,  None),
    ("privtb",   [STCR_R3_CR1, TB1_0_R4_8],     {"r3": PSR_USER, "r4": 1},       V_PRIV,     0x10008, PSR_USER,  None),
    ("unimpl",   [STCR_R3_CR1, PROM_CALL],      {"r3": PSR_USER},                V_UNIMPL,   0x10008, PSR_USER,  None),
    ("error",    [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],               {"r3": 0x10, "r5": DATA + 1},    V_ERROR,    0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [0x14000000 | (6 << 21) | (5 << 16)]),       # handler at 0x40: ld r6,r5,0 with r5 odd -> 2nd fault
    ("dslot",    [BR_N_PLUS16, DIVU_R2_R3_R0],  {"r3": 0x10},                    V_DIV0,     0x10008, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("errortb",  [TB1_0_R3_10],                 {"r3": 1},                       V_ERROR,    0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("misaligntb", [TB1_0_R3_4],                {"r3": 1},                       V_MISALIGN, 0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("unimpltb", [TB1_0_R3_5],                  {"r3": 1},                       V_UNIMPL,   0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("div0tb",   [TB1_0_R3_8],                  {"r3": 1},                       V_DIV0,     0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("ovftb",    [TB1_0_R3_9],                  {"r3": 1},                       V_OVF,      0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("vbrtb",    [STCR_R5_CR7, TB1_0_R3_7],     {"r3": 1, "r5": VBR_TEST},       V_BOUNDS,   0x10008, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("trapfrozen", [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],             {"r3": 0x11},                    V_BOUNDS,   0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [TB1_0_R3_7]),                               # handler at 0x40: tb1 0,r3,7 with SFRZ set -> a TRAP is not re-routed to ERROR
    ("ovfc",     [STCR_R5_CR1, ADD_R2_R3_R4],   {"r3": 0x7fffffff, "r4": 1, "r5": PSR_CARRY}, V_OVF, 0x10008, PSR_CARRY, None),
    ("indclr",   [STCR_R5_CR1, ADD_R2_R3_R4],   {"r3": 0x7fffffff, "r4": 1, "r5": PSR_INDCLR}, V_OVF, 0x10008, PSR_INDCLR, None),
    ("umisalign", [STCR_R5_CR1, LD_R2_R3_0],    {"r3": DATA + 1, "r5": PSR_USER}, V_MISALIGN, 0x10008, PSR_USER,  None),
    ("uovf",     [STCR_R5_CR1, ADD_R2_R3_R4],   {"r3": 0x7fffffff, "r4": 1, "r5": PSR_USER}, V_OVF, 0x10008, PSR_USER,  None),
    ("errovf",   [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],               {"r3": 0x7fffffff, "r4": 1},     V_ERROR,    0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [ADD_R2_R3_R4]),                             # handler at 0x40: an OVERFLOW (non-trap) with SFRZ set -> re-routed to ERROR
    ("errdiv0",  [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],               {"r3": 0x10, "r5": PSR_FRZSUP},  V_ERROR,    0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [STCR_R5_CR1, DIVU_R2_R3_R0]),               # handler: clear SFD1 (SFRZ kept), divu by zero -> DIV0 frozen -> ERROR
    ("errpriv",  [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],               {"r3": 0x10, "r5": PSR_FRZUSER}, V_ERROR,    0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [STCR_R5_CR1, LDCR_R2_CR1]),                 # handler: drop to USER mode (SFRZ kept), ldcr -> PRIVILEGE frozen -> ERROR
    ("errunimpl", [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],              {"r3": 0x10, "r5": PSR_FRZUSER}, V_ERROR,    0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [STCR_R5_CR1, PROM_CALL]),                   # handler: drop to USER mode (SFRZ kept), prom_call -> UNIMPLEMENTED frozen -> ERROR
    ("privsuptb", [TB1_0_R3_6],                 {"r3": 1},                       V_PRIV,     0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("udiv0",    [STCR_R3_CR1, DIVU_R2_R3_R0],  {"r3": PSR_USER},                V_DIV0,     0x10008, PSR_USER,  None),
    ("usertb",   [TB1_0_R3_128],                {"r3": 1},                       V_USER0,    0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("resid50",  [TB1_0_R3_50],                 {"r3": 1},                       V_RESID,    0x10004, PSR_RESET, None),
    ("sfu1h",    [DIVU_R2_R3_R0],               {"r3": 0x10, "r5": 0x60, "r4": 0x10}, V_SFU1, 0x10004, PSR_RESET,
                 [DIVU_R6_R5_R4]),                             # handler at 0x40: a legal divu with SFD1 set -> SFU1 (114) -> fallback HALT
    ("live",     [DIVU_R2_R3_R4],               {"r3": 0x60, "r4": 0x10},        None,       None,    None,      None),
    ("attrib",   [DIVU_R2_R3_R4],               {"r3": 0x10, "r4": 0x10},        None,       None,    None,      None),
]
EXPECT_R2 = {"live": 6, "attrib": 1}
VBR_OF = {"vbrtb": VBR_TEST}                     # rows that relocate the vector table; every other row runs with VBR == 0
#  NEGATIVE CONTROLS: rows whose CORRECT result is the fallback HALT.  They pin the boundary the diff keeps on purpose --
#  vectors 11..113/116..127 and SFU1 (114/115) still stop the machine -- and separate the shipped D1 form from the rejected
#  D4 (tail-default-delivers) and from delivering SFU1 (row m88kexcsfu1).  A mutant that delivers them turns these rows RED.
EXPECT_RESULT = {"resid50": "HALT", "sfu1h": "HALT"}
PSR_WANT = {"ovfc": 0x9000000b}                  # MODE | C | SFD1 | IND | SFRZ: carry PRESERVED through the exception path
#  indclr wants the default PSR_EXC (0x8000000b): IND was CLEAR before the fault and must be SET by the exception path;
#  EPSR keeps the pre-fault 0x80000000.  A write that drops `| M88K_PSR_IND' leaves 0x80000009 -> bad=psr.
EXPECT_VECTOR = {"resid50": 0x032, "sfu1h": 0x072}   # the vector the fallback diagnostic must NAME for an expected-HALT row

class Sess:
    def __init__(self):
        stub = "/tmp/gx_m88k_exc_%d.bin" % os.getpid()
        with open(stub, "wb") as f:
            f.write(struct.pack(">I", 0xf4005800))          # or r0,r0,r0 so the machine constructs
        self.pid, self.fd = pty.fork()
        if self.pid == 0:
            os.execvp(BIN, [BIN, "-V", "-E", "testm88k", "-M", "64", "0x10000:%s" % stub])
            os._exit(127)
        self.buf = ""
    def rd(self, t=0.4):
        r, _, _ = select.select([self.fd], [], [], t)
        if self.fd not in r:
            return True
        try:
            d = os.read(self.fd, 65536)
        except OSError:
            return False
        if not d:
            return False
        self.buf += d.decode("latin1", "replace")
        return True
    def wait_prompt(self, mark, timeout=30):
        t = time.time()
        while time.time() - t < timeout:
            if not self.rd():
                return False
            if len(self.buf) > mark and self.buf[mark:].rstrip().endswith("GXemul>"):
                return True
        return False
    def send(self, sx, timeout=30):
        mark = len(self.buf)
        b = (sx + "\n").encode("latin1"); n = 0
        while n < len(b):
            n += os.write(self.fd, b[n:])
        self.wait_prompt(mark, timeout)
        return mark
    def cr(self, name):
        m = self.send("reg 0,0")
        mm = re.search(r"(?<![A-Z])%s=0x([0-9a-f]{8})" % name, self.buf[m:])
        return int(mm.group(1), 16) if mm else None
    def gpr(self, n):
        m = self.send("reg")
        mm = re.search(r"r%-2d\s*=\s*0x([0-9a-f]{8})" % n, self.buf[m:])
        return int(mm.group(1), 16) if mm else None
    def pc(self):
        m = self.send("reg")
        mm = re.search(r"pc\s*=\s*0x([0-9a-f]{8})", self.buf[m:])
        return int(mm.group(1), 16) if mm else None
    def close(self):
        try:
            os.write(self.fd, b"quit\n"); time.sleep(0.3); os.kill(self.pid, 9); os.waitpid(self.pid, 0)
        except Exception:
            pass

def fmt(v):
    return ("0x%08x" % v) if isinstance(v, int) else str(v)

def run_row(name, prog, regs, vector, fault_pc, epsr_exp, handler, grace=6.0):
    s = Sess()
    if not s.wait_prompt(0, 60):
        s.close(); return dict(result="NOBOOT")
    vbr = VBR_OF.get(name, 0)
    entry = (vbr + 8 * vector) if vector is not None else None
    words = [MARK] + prog + [SELF]
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        s.send("put w 0x%x, 0x%08x" % (CODE + 4 * i, w))
    for base in sorted({0, vbr}):                       # every entry spins unless a handler is planted (both tables if relocated)
        for v in VECTORS:
            s.send("put w 0x%x, 0x%08x" % (base + 8 * v, SELF))
    if entry is not None:
        s.send("put w 0x%x, 0x%08x" % (entry, SELF))
    if handler:
        for i, w in enumerate(handler):
            s.send("put w 0x%x, 0x%08x" % (8 * V_DIV0 + 4 * i, w))
        s.send("put w 0x%x, 0x%08x" % (8 * V_DIV0 + 4 * len(handler), SELF))
    s.send("put w 0x%x, 0x%08x" % (DATA, 0x0badf00d))
    for r, v in regs.items():
        s.send("%s=0x%x" % (r, v))
    s.send("r10=0x12345678"); s.send("r2=0xdeadbeef")
    if vector is not None:
        s.send("breakpoint add 0x%x" % entry)
    s.send("pc=0x%x" % CODE)
    mark = len(s.buf)
    os.write(s.fd, b"continue\n")
    t = time.time()
    while time.time() - t < grace:
        s.rd(0.3)
        if s.buf[mark:].rstrip().endswith("GXemul>"):
            break
    if not s.buf[mark:].rstrip().endswith("GXemul>"):
        os.write(s.fd, b"\x03"); s.wait_prompt(len(s.buf), 15)
    tr = s.buf[mark:]
    #  HALT is the fallback's diagnostic AND the machine-stopped observation (codex, pass 3: a mutant that keeps the
    #  message and drops the stop would otherwise classify as HALT); an expected-HALT row must also see ITS vector named.
    diag = re.search(r"unimplemented[^\r\n]*vector=0x([0-9a-f]+)", tr)
    stopped = "machines stopped" in tr           # emul.c's `All machines stopped.' -- the ONE stop observation (pass 4:
    halted = diag is not None and stopped        # an `or "stopped" in tr' disjunct had made the exact term dead code)
    if halted and name in EXPECT_VECTOR and int(diag.group(1), 16) != EXPECT_VECTOR[name]:
        halted = False                              # halted on some OTHER vector: not the row's answer
    #  LEVEL channel (Fable review seat, pass 2): main.c lowers every subsystem to WARNING after startup, so a
    #  free-running `continue' prints an ERROR-level `[ exception <CLASS>: ]' line and stays silent at INFO.  A
    #  delivered row that carries the line has the pre-fix level (M_LEVEL) -- #261's opt-in break-on-ERROR would
    #  then stop the emulator into the debugger on a user process's divide by zero.
    levelmsg = re.search(r"exception (MISALIGNED_ACCESS|UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE|PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION|"
                         r"BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION|ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE|INTEGER_OVERFLOW|ERROR)", tr) is not None
    tailhalt = "internal error" in tr
    pc = s.pc(); r2 = s.gpr(2); r9 = s.gpr(9)
    sxip, snip, sfip, psr, epsr = s.cr("SXIP"), s.cr("SNIP"), s.cr("SFIP"), s.cr("PSR"), s.cr("EPSR")
    s.close()
    started = (r9 == 0x12345678)
    res = dict(pc=pc, sxip=sxip, snip=snip, sfip=sfip, psr=psr, epsr=epsr, r2=r2, transcript=tr)
    if not started:
        res["result"] = "NOSTART"; return res
    if vector is None:
        ok = (not stopped) and r2 == EXPECT_R2[name]
        res["result"] = "DONE" if ok else ("STOP" if stopped else "BADREGS"); return res
    if halted:
        res["result"] = "HALT"
        if name == "sfu1h" and pc != 8 * V_DIV0:
            res["result"] = "BADREGS"; res["bad"] = ["stage1"]   # halted before the handler ran (the pre-fix shape)
    elif tailhalt:
        res["result"] = "TAILHALT"
    elif stopped:
        res["result"] = "STOP"
    elif pc != entry:
        res["result"] = "STOP"          # ran past its grace without the entry breakpoint firing
    else:
        want = dict(sxip=(fault_pc | XIP_V), psr=PSR_WANT.get(name, PSR_EXC), epsr=epsr_exp, r2=0xdeadbeef)
        if name in ("error", "trapfrozen", "errovf", "errdiv0", "errpriv", "errunimpl"):
            # the second fault runs with SFRZ set: the shadows stay FROZEN at the first fault's values.  For
            # `trapfrozen' the second fault is a TRAP, which the manual (:8633-8636, 6.10 :10613-10614) exempts from
            # the ERROR re-route: it must deliver to ITS OWN vector (0x38), shadows still frozen.  M_SFRZTRAP sends it to 0x50.
            want.update(sxip=(0x10004 | XIP_V), snip=(0x10008 | XIP_V), sfip=(0x1000c | XIP_V), epsr=PSR_RESET)
        elif name == "dslot":
            # the else-arm of the delay-slot branch: SNIP = (pc + 4) | V, SFIP = delay_target | V.  br.n +16 puts
            # delay_target at 0x10014 while slot_pc+4 is 0x1000c, so the two channels are DIFFERENT numbers (with
            # br.n +8 they were both 0x1000e and M_SFIPNOTGT / M_DSLOTSWAP escaped 10/10 -- Opus, pass 2).
            want.update(snip=((fault_pc + 4) | XIP_V), sfip=((CODE + 4 + 16) | XIP_V))
            assert want["snip"] != want["sfip"], "dslot geometry collapsed: SNIP and SFIP would be one number"
        else:
            want.update(snip=((fault_pc + 4) | XIP_V), sfip=((fault_pc + 8) | XIP_V))
        bad = [k for k, v in want.items() if res.get(k) != v]
        if levelmsg:
            bad.append("level")
        res["result"] = "DELIVER" if not bad else "BADREGS"
        res["bad"] = bad
    return res

def selftest():
    s = Sess()
    ok = s.wait_prompt(0, 60)
    psr = s.cr("PSR") if ok else None
    s.close()
    return psr == PSR_RESET, psr

def main():
    ok, psr = selftest()
    print("M88KEXC_SELFTEST=%s psr_at_reset=%s (want 0x80000002)" % ("OK" if ok else "FAIL", fmt(psr)), flush=True)
    delivered = 0; total = 0; controls_bad = []
    for name, prog, regs, vector, fault_pc, epsr_exp, handler in ROWS:
        res = run_row(name, prog, regs, vector, fault_pc, epsr_exp, handler)
        print("M88KEXC_ROW=%-9s RESULT=%-8s pc=%s sxip=%s snip=%s sfip=%s psr=%s epsr=%s r2=%s%s" % (
            name, res.get("result"), fmt(res.get("pc")), fmt(res.get("sxip")), fmt(res.get("snip")),
            fmt(res.get("sfip")), fmt(res.get("psr")), fmt(res.get("epsr")), fmt(res.get("r2")),
            (" bad=" + ",".join(res["bad"])) if res.get("bad") else ""), flush=True)
        if vector is not None:
            total += 1
            if res.get("result") == EXPECT_RESULT.get(name, "DELIVER"):
                delivered += 1
        elif res.get("result") != "DONE":
            controls_bad.append(name)
        if os.environ.get("M88KEXC_VERBOSE"):
            print("---- transcript ----"); print(res.get("transcript", "")[-1200:]); print("--------------------")
    print("M88KEXC_RESULT=%d/%d" % (delivered, total), flush=True)
    if controls_bad:
        print("M88KEXC_CONTROLS=BAD %s" % ",".join(controls_bad), flush=True)
    print("M88KEXC_DONE", flush=True)
    #  exit status: the gate can rely on it (a row printing a failure word while the process exits 0 was a pass-2 finding)
    sys.exit(0 if (ok and delivered == total and not controls_bad) else 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/bash
# m88kexcdeliver KILL TABLE 5: the v5 probe (29 fault rows + 2 controls; 2 rows EXPECT HALT) against the pass-2 escapes and the
# repaired rows.  SCRATCH CLONE (/tmp/gxm88kexc_kill, a cp -a of build/ = the FIX build), frozen probe copy, sentinel per
# mutant, restore FROM GXEMUL-SEC (never a backup), cmp + rebuild before the sentinel is cleared.  Never touches a project tree.
set -u
S=/mnt/c/DocumentNoSnc/CC/GXEMUL/GXEMUL-SEC; C=/tmp/gxm88kexc_kill; f=src/cpus/cpu_m88k.c
OUT=/mnt/c/DocumentNoSnc/CC/GXEMUL/_scratchpad/m88kexc/killtable5
SP=/mnt/c/Users/User00/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--DocumentNoSnc-CC-GXEMUL/8e474f41-4d47-4c99-bf11-3406a84c4fcd/scratchpad
PROBE=/mnt/c/DocumentNoSnc/CC/GXEMUL/_scratchpad/m88kexc/m88k_exc_probe.v5.frozen.py
WANT=29/29
mkdir -p "$OUT"; echo "KILLTABLE5_START $(date +%H:%M:%S)"
[ -d "$C" ] || { echo "clone absent"; exit 1; }
[ -e "$C/.MUTANT" ] && { echo "clone carries a sentinel -- restore first"; exit 1; }
cmp -s "$C/$f" "$S/$f" && echo "clone baseline == SEC (the fix)" || { echo "clone DIVERGES from SEC -- re-baselining from SEC"; cp "$S/$f" "$C/$f"; }
cp "$PROBE" "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py"; echo "frozen5 md5 $(md5sum "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py" | cut -c1-8)"
if ! [ "$C/gxemul" -nt "$C/$f" ]; then echo "clone binary stale -- rebuilding the baseline"; ( cd "$C/src/cpus" && rm -f cpu_m88k.o && make -s -j4 >"$OUT/build_BASE.log" 2>&1 ); ( cd "$C" && make -s -j4 >>"$OUT/build_BASE.log" 2>&1 ); fi
[ "$C/gxemul" -nt "$C/$f" ] || { echo "BASE rebuild did not produce a fresh binary"; exit 1; }
python3 -u "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py" "$C/gxemul" > "$OUT/BASE.out" 2>&1; echo "BASE rc=$?"
grep -E 'M88KEXC_RESULT|SELFTEST|CONTROLS' "$OUT/BASE.out"
grep -q "M88KEXC_RESULT=$WANT" "$OUT/BASE.out" || { echo "BASE is not $WANT -- the baseline or a row is wrong, aborting"; grep -E 'M88KEXC_ROW' "$OUT/BASE.out" | grep -v 'RESULT=DELIVER\|RESULT=DONE' | cut -c1-140; exit 1; }
for M in M_OVFSUPONLY M_MISSUPONLY M_SFRZMIS M_SFRZNOOVF M_SFRZNODIV0 M_SFRZNOPRIV M_SFRZNOUNIMPL M_NOSFD1; do
	echo "=== $M $(date +%H:%M:%S) ==="
	echo "$f $M" > "$C/.MUTANT"
	if ! python3 "$SP/mut_m88kexc.py" "$C" "$M" > "$OUT/mut_$M.log" 2>&1; then
		echo "$M: MUTANT-TEXT-NOT-FOUND (see mut_$M.log)"; tail -2 "$OUT/mut_$M.log"; cp "$S/$f" "$C/$f"; rm -f "$C/.MUTANT"; continue
	fi
	( cd "$C/src/cpus" && rm -f cpu_m88k.o && make -s -j4 >"$OUT/build_$M.log" 2>&1 ); ( cd "$C" && make -s -j4 >>"$OUT/build_$M.log" 2>&1 )
	if [ "$C/gxemul" -nt "$C/$f" ]; then
		python3 -u "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py" "$C/gxemul" > "$OUT/$M.out" 2>&1
		echo "$M $(grep -o 'M88KEXC_RESULT=[0-9]*/[0-9]*' "$OUT/$M.out") $(grep -o 'M88KEXC_CONTROLS=BAD.*' "$OUT/$M.out")"
		python3 - "$OUT/$M.out" <<'PY'
import sys,re
exp={"resid50":"HALT","sfu1h":"HALT"}
for l in open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"):
    m=re.match(r"M88KEXC_ROW=(\S+)\s+RESULT=(\S+)(.*)",l)
    if not m: continue
    name,res,rest=m.groups()
    want=exp.get(name,"DELIVER") if name not in ("live","attrib") else "DONE"
    if res!=want:
        bad=re.search(r"bad=(\S+)",rest); print("    RED %-10s %-8s %s"%(name,res,bad.group(0) if bad else ""))
PY
	else
		echo "$M: BUILD FAILED (binary not newer than source) -- see build_$M.log"; tail -3 "$OUT/build_$M.log"
	fi
	cp "$S/$f" "$C/$f"
	cmp -s "$C/$f" "$S/$f" || { echo "RESTORE FAILED -- sentinel left in place"; exit 1; }
	( cd "$C/src/cpus" && rm -f cpu_m88k.o && make -s -j4 >"$OUT/restore_$M.log" 2>&1 ); ( cd "$C" && make -s -j4 >>"$OUT/restore_$M.log" 2>&1 )
	[ "$C/gxemul" -nt "$C/$f" ] && rm -f "$C/.MUTANT" || { echo "restore rebuild stale -- sentinel left in place"; exit 1; }
done
python3 -u "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py" "$C/gxemul" > "$OUT/BASE_final.out" 2>&1; grep -o 'M88KEXC_RESULT=[0-9]*/[0-9]*' "$OUT/BASE_final.out"
[ -e "$C/.MUTANT" ] && echo "SENTINEL PRESENT" || echo "clone clean: no sentinel"
echo "KILLTABLE5_DONE $(date +%H:%M:%S)"
echo "--- HEAD v5 measurement (floor a, final instrument): /tmp/gxopus501p4"
H=/tmp/gxopus501p4; git -C "$S" show HEAD:src/cpus/cpu_m88k.c > /tmp/head_cpu_m88k.c; cmp -s "$H/$f" /tmp/head_cpu_m88k.c && echo "$H cpu_m88k.c == HEAD" || echo "$H != HEAD"
python3 -u "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py" "$H/gxemul" > "$OUT/../probe_v5_head.out" 2>&1; grep -E 'M88KEXC_RESULT|SELFTEST' "$OUT/../probe_v5_head.out"; grep 'M88KEXC_ROW' "$OUT/../probe_v5_head.out" | grep -v 'RESULT=HALT' | cut -c1-100
echo "--- final v5 run on the rebuilt build/ (must be 29/29)"
python3 -u "$OUT/m88k_exc_probe.frozen5.py" /mnt/c/DocumentNoSnc/CC/GXEMUL/build/gxemul > "$OUT/../probe_v5_fix_final.out" 2>&1; grep -E 'M88KEXC_RESULT' "$OUT/../probe_v5_fix_final.out"
echo "KILLTABLE5_ALL_DONE $(date +%H:%M:%S)"

CHANGELOG.md-12428-## Forty-first round (#271, #272) — VGA CRTC: a guest-reachable host abort, and a driver-reachable diagnostic flood
CHANGELOG.md-12429-Both corrections are in `devices/dev_vga.c`, which is **not** one of the five divergent files, so the two trees stay byte-identical. They were found by the same sweep and share one probe rig, but they are **not the same shape** — #271 is a control-flow change plus a latch, #272 is output-only — so this round carries **two independent probes** and neither is allowed to stand in for the other.
CHANGELOG.md:12430:- **#271** `devices/dev_vga.c` (both trees): **two guest byte stores killed the emulator process.** Selecting CRTC index `0xff` and then writing a mode byte outside the eleven implemented modes reached `default: fatal("TODO! video mode change hack …"); exit(1);` inside `vga_crtc_reg_write()` — measured on the committed build: wait status `exited, code 1`, pty EOF, the `fatal()` text as the last output, while an *accepted* mode byte (`0x03`) survived. A guest must not be able to `exit()` the host — the **#167** / **#240** / **#264** rule — so the abort is gone. The arm now **returns** rather than breaking: a *rejected* mode must have **no side effects**, and falling through would have run the geometry/resize block and then `reset_palette(d, grayscale)` with `grayscale == 0`, i.e. a rejected write would clear the screen and reset the palette to colour. (The fall-through is *not* a **#182**-shape stale-length overrun — the geometry left in `d` is self-consistent — so this is side-effect suppression, not a memory-safety fix.) `d->crtc_reg[0xff]` is deliberately **left holding the rejected byte**: every other unhandled CRTC index is RAM-backed too, so making `0xff` read back differently would be the inconsistency, and the previously accepted mode is not reconstructible anyway (`0x00`/`0x01`, `0x02`/`0x03` and `0x09`/`0x0d` produce identical geometry, and a restore would need new state *and* a change in the caller). Because removing the abort turns a one-shot exit into a repeatable ungated `fatal()` — the **#265** → **#269** shape — the warning is latched to **once per device instance** through a new `invalid_mode_warned` field in `struct vga_data`, deliberately **not** cleared by `register_reset()` (an accepted mode set is the only guest-reachable reset here, so clearing it there would let a guest re-arm the flood) and zeroed by the `memset` in `dev_vga_init()`. `fatal()` is kept rather than gated: exactly one visible line is what a deficiency tripwire should leave under `-q`, the mode the boot harness runs.
CHANGELOG.md-12431-- **#272** `devices/dev_vga.c` (both trees): the **outer** `default:` arm of the same function reported every unhandled CRTC index with an ungated `fatal()` — measured **1.00 host lines per guest data store**; arming the index is silent and one index store then licenses unlimited one-store repeats. Only indices `0x0a`–`0x0f` are handled (measured by sweep), so **every horizontal/vertical timing register an ordinary VGA driver writes during a mode set lands here** — this is reachable by legitimate driver software, not only by a hostile guest. The emulator survives it; this is a flood, not an abort. It is now `debugmsg(SUBSYS_DEVICE, "vga", VERBOSITY_DEBUG, …)` carrying the same payload. A latch was wrong here: the payload is *variable* (index and value), so latching would hide real information, and this is ordinary-if-unimplemented traffic rather than a deficiency tripwire, so it should simply be silent in a normal run. Output only; nothing the guest can observe changes.
CHANGELOG.md-12432-Verified: build **0/0** both trees (223 pmax / 224 arc objects); **pmax 15/15 + arc 13/13 → `uid=0(root)`**; log-hygiene greps on both boot pty logs **0** for `vga_crtc_reg_write`, for `video mode change hack`, and for `panic`. **#271 probe, 11/11:** the two-store sequence that exited with code 1 on the committed build now leaves the process alive and answering (`dead=False`, `pc` readable); a witness byte planted in the handled register `0x0e` **survives** a rejected mode (`0x5a` → `0x5a`), proving the `return` suppressed the side effects, while an accepted `0x03` zeroes it (`0x5a` → `0x00`), proving the accepted path still performs the mode change; `crtc_reg[0xff]` reads back `0x55`, the rejected byte; **12 rejected sequences in one session produce exactly 1 host line**, and 3 more after an accepted mode set — the device reset — produce **0**, so the latch cannot be re-armed. **#272 probe, 8/8, both halves:** under `-V step` the call site still fires 8/8 = **1.00 per store** (`debugmsg.c:181` skips the verbosity test while `single_step` is set, so this proves the site is live, not that it is ungated); suppression is therefore measured **free-running**, with the CPU parked in a loop that stores to the data port and counts its own iterations — **93,454,400 stores in 2.51 s produced 0 lines** (10 bytes of host output total). Two controls keep that from being a blind rig: the same free run with `-v -v` (verbosity DEBUG) prints **313,468 lines for 314,080 stores**, and the pre-fix binary at default verbosity prints **418,881 lines for 420,160 stores** — i.e. the old `fatal()` did flood a normal, non-stepping run, and the new silence is the verbosity gate.

The write loop steps `tlbi++` per halfword, so an 8-byte `sd` writes FOUR entries.  **The worst case is the last legal 8-byte slot.**  8-byte accesses are 8-ALIGNED (the guest path cannot deliver an unaligned `len == 8` -- ordinary `ld`/`sd` raise ADEL/ADES without calling `memory_rw`, and the `ldl/ldr/sdl/sdr` helper masks the address itself), so the reachable offsets are `0x00, 0x08, ... 0xd8`. /*
 *  m88k_memory_transaction_debug_dump():
 *
 *  Debug dump of the memory transaction registers of a cpu.
 */
static void m88k_memory_transaction_debug_dump(struct cpu *cpu, int n)
{
	uint32_t dmt = cpu->cd.m88k.dmt[n];

	debug("[ DMT%i: ", n);
	if (dmt & DMT_VALID) {
		if (dmt & DMT_BO)
			debug("Little-Endian, ");
		else
			debug("Big-Endian, ");
		if (dmt & DMT_DAS)
			debug("Supervisor, ");
		else
			debug("User, ");
		if (dmt & DMT_DOUB1)
			debug("DOUB1, ");
		if (dmt & DMT_LOCKBAR)
			debug("LOCKBAR, ");
		if (dmt & DMT_WRITE)
			debug("store, ");
		else {
			debug("load.%c(r%i), ",
			    dmt & DMT_SIGNED? 's' : 'u',
			    DMT_DREGBITS(dmt));
		}
		debug("bytebits=0x%x ]\n", DMT_ENBITS(dmt));

		debug("[ DMD%i: 0x%08" PRIx32"; ", n, cpu->cd.m88k.dmd[n]);
		debug("DMA%i: 0x%08" PRIx32" ]\n", n, cpu->cd.m88k.dma[n]);
	} else
		debug("not valid ]\n");
}


/*
 *  m88k_exception():
 *
 *  Cause an exception.
 */
void m88k_exception(struct cpu *cpu, int vector, int is_trap)
{
	bool update_shadow_regs = true;
	bool implemented = false;

	// TODO: Use a const char * instead or something like that, inside the switch...

	switch (vector) {

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_RESET:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "RESET", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTERRUPT:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "INTERRUPT", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "INSTRUCTION_ACCESS", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_DATA_ACCESS:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "DATA_ACCESS", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_MISALIGNED_ACCESS:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "MISALIGNED_ACCESS", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTEGER_OVERFLOW:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "INTEGER_OVERFLOW", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_ERROR:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "ERROR", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_SFU1_PRECISE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "SFU1_PRECISE", VERBOSITY_ERROR, "");
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_SFU1_IMPRECISE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "SFU1_IMPRECISE", VERBOSITY_ERROR, "");
		break;

	case 0x80:	/*  up to OpenBSD 5.2  */
	case 0x1c2:	/*  from OpenBSD 5.3 and forward...  */
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "syscall", VERBOSITY_INFO,
		    "r13=%i", cpu->cd.m88k.r[13]);
#if 0
		fatal("[ syscall %i(", cpu->cd.m88k.r[13]);
		m88k_cpu_functioncall_trace(cpu, 8);
		fatal(") ]\n");
#endif
		break;

	case MVMEPROM_VECTOR:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "MVMEPROM_VECTOR", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		break;

	default:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "unknown vector",
		    vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START ? VERBOSITY_ERROR
		    : VERBOSITY_INFO, "0x%03x", vector);
	}

	/*
	 *  m88kexcdeliver (2026-09-05): the seven trap-like classes above are
	 *  DELIVERED (VBR + 8*vector, SXIP = the faulting instruction, SNIP = the
	 *  next one, destination register unchanged -- MC88100 UM 6.4.3/6.5/6.6/
	 *  6.8.3), like the four this fallback never covered.  Before, any of them
	 *  stopped EVERY guest CPU here: one divu by zero, in either mode, ended
	 *  the emulation (measured: regress/m88k_exc_probe.py rows div0/udiv0).
	 *  Pre-existing upstream code (this fallback is the 0.7.0 import),
	 *  surfaced by the 2026-09-05 retrospective of #380.  What still lands
	 *  here, by design: SFU1_PRECISE/IMPRECISE (114/115; row m88kexcsfu1 --
	 *  faithful delivery needs the rest of the SFU1 exception state, which
	 *  the fork does not write) and vectors 11..113/116..127 (117 vectors
	 *  with the two SFU1 ones), which no literal-constant raise site names
	 *  but a supervisor tb0/tb1/tcnd can name directly (row
	 *  m88kexctaildefault; the probe's resid50/sfu1h rows pin that they
	 *  STILL halt).
	 */
	if (vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START && !implemented) {
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "unimplemented",
		    VERBOSITY_ERROR, "vector=0x%03x pc=0x%08x",
			vector,
			(int)cpu->pc);
		for (int j = 0; j < cpu->machine->ncpus; ++j)
			cpu->machine->cpus[j]->running = false;
		m88k_pc_to_pointers(cpu);
		return;
	}

	/*  Stuff common for all exceptions:  */
	if (cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR] & M88K_PSR_SFRZ) {
		/*
		 *  Non-trap exceptions when the shadow freeze bit is already
		 *  set result in an Error exception:
		 */
		if (!is_trap) {
			vector = M88K_EXCEPTION_ERROR;
			fatal("[ SFRZ already set in PSR => ERROR ]\n");
		}

		update_shadow_regs = false;
	} else {
		/*  Freeze shadow registers, and save the PSR:  */
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_EPSR] = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR];
	}

	m88k_stcr(cpu, cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR]
	    | M88K_PSR_SFRZ	/*  Freeze shadow registers,          */
	    | M88K_PSR_IND	/*  disable interrupts,               */
	    | M88K_PSR_SFD1	/*  disable the floating point unit,  */
	    | M88K_PSR_MODE,	/*  and switch to supervisor mode.    */
	    M88K_CR_PSR, 0);

	if (update_shadow_regs) {
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SSBR] = 0;

		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SXIP] = cpu->pc | M88K_XIP_V;

		/*  SNIP is the address to return to, when executing rte:  */
		if (cpu->delay_slot) {
			if (vector == M88K_EXCEPTION_DATA_ACCESS) {
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.delay_target | M88K_NIP_V;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP]+4;
			} else if (vector == M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS) {
				/*  If we are in a delay slot, then pc is
				    something like 0xc6000 here (not 0xc5ffc).  */
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.delay_target | M88K_NIP_V;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = 0;
			} else {
				/*  Perhaps something like this could work:  */
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = (cpu->pc + 4) | M88K_NIP_V;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.delay_target | M88K_NIP_V;
			}
		} else {
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = (cpu->pc + 4) | M88K_NIP_V;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP]+4;
		}

		if (vector == M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS)
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SXIP] |= M88K_XIP_E;
	}

	cpu->pc = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_VBR] + 8 * vector;

	if (cpu->delay_slot)
		cpu->delay_slot = EXCEPTION_IN_DELAY_SLOT;
	else
		cpu->delay_slot = NOT_DELAYED;

	/*  Default to no memory transactions:  */
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT0] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD0] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA0] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT1] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD1] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA1] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT2] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD2] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA2] = 0;

	/*  Vector-specific handling:  */
	if (vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START) {
		switch (vector) {

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_RESET:
			fatal("[ m88k_exception: reset ]\n");
			for (int j = 0; j < cpu->machine->ncpus; ++j)
				cpu->machine->cpus[j]->running = false;
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTERRUPT:
			/*  When returning with rte, we want to re-  */
			/*  execute the interrupted instruction:  */
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] -= 4;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] -= 4;
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS:
			/*  When returning with rte, we want to re-  */
			/*  execute the instruction in SXIP, not SNIP/SFIP,  */
			/*  (unless the exception was in a delay-slot):  */
			if (!(cpu->delay_slot & EXCEPTION_IN_DELAY_SLOT)) {
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = 0;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = 0;
			}
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_DATA_ACCESS:
			/*  Update the memory transaction registers:  */
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT0] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmt[0];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD0] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmd[0];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA0] = cpu->cd.m88k.dma[0];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT1] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmt[1];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD1] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmd[1];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA1] = cpu->cd.m88k.dma[1];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT2] = 0;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD2] = 0;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA2] = 0;
			m88k_memory_transaction_debug_dump(cpu, 0);
			m88k_memory_transaction_debug_dump(cpu, 1);
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_MISALIGNED_ACCESS:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTEGER_OVERFLOW:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_ERROR:
			/*  m88kexcdeliver: OUTSIDE A DELAY SLOT the common path above
			    is already the architectural contract for these -- SXIP =
			    the faulting instruction, SNIP = the next one, SFIP = SNIP+4,
			    and rte resumes at SNIP (UM 6.4.3.1.4: "the processor
			    hardware does not use the SXIP on return from an exception"),
			    so the upstream doubt that sat here in an #if 0 ("should the
			    PC be backed up one step?") is answered NO: 6.5.x/6.8.3 say
			    the destination register is unchanged (6.6: and the carry
			    bit, for the overflow case), and a handler that wants
			    re-execution arranges SNIP/SFIP itself.  INSIDE a delay slot
			    the else-arm above ("Perhaps something like this could
			    work") is upstream's guess and the manual disagrees (Table
			    6-3: the shadows copy XIP/NIP/FIP, and UM 6.2 defines FIP as
			    the taken branch's target while the branch executes, so for
			    a fault in its delay slot NIP = target, FIP = target+4) --
			    pre-existing, now reachable by ordinary faults, row
			    m88kdslotshadow.
			    Without these labels the classes reached the default: below,
			    which stops the cpu -- the one-site fix was measured to do
			    exactly that; with them, nothing below 128 reaches that
			    default any more (it is unreachable code kept as the
			    tripwire for an eighth class).  ERROR arrives here by TWO
			    routes: the SFRZ re-route above (a fault inside a handler,
			    shadows deliberately frozen at the FIRST fault's values --
			    SXIP then names that first fault, not this one) and a
			    supervisor tb0/tb1/tcnd naming vector 10 directly (shadows
			    updated normally when that trap is taken UNFROZEN; inside a
			    handler it takes the is_trap exemption above and arrives
			    here with the shadows frozen).  Not modelled, disclosed: scoreboard
			    capture (the shadow-update path writes SSBR = 0; a frozen
			    SSBR keeps its old value) and fcr2/fcr4/fcr5 for the divide.  */
			break;

#if 0
		// TODO: Read up more about SFU1 exceptions and how the
		// control registers look when they happen.
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_SFU1_PRECISE:
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = 0; //?
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = 0;
			//cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] -= 4;
			//cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] -= 4;
			break;
#endif

		default:debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "m88k",
			    VERBOSITY_ERROR, "internal error");
			cpu->running = false;
		}
	}

	m88k_pc_to_pointers(cpu);
}

 *  tracing.

	int32_t d16, d26;

/*
 *  m88k_exception():
 *
 *  Cause an exception.
 */
void m88k_exception(struct cpu *cpu, int vector, int is_trap)
{
	bool update_shadow_regs = true;
	bool implemented = false;

	// TODO: Use a const char * instead or something like that, inside the switch...

	switch (vector) {

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_RESET:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "RESET", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTERRUPT:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "INTERRUPT", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "INSTRUCTION_ACCESS", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_DATA_ACCESS:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "DATA_ACCESS", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_MISALIGNED_ACCESS:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "MISALIGNED_ACCESS", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTEGER_OVERFLOW:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "INTEGER_OVERFLOW", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_ERROR:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "ERROR", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		implemented = true;	/*  m88kexcdeliver  */
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_SFU1_PRECISE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "SFU1_PRECISE", VERBOSITY_ERROR, "");
		break;

	case M88K_EXCEPTION_SFU1_IMPRECISE:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "SFU1_IMPRECISE", VERBOSITY_ERROR, "");
		break;

	case 0x80:	/*  up to OpenBSD 5.2  */
	case 0x1c2:	/*  from OpenBSD 5.3 and forward...  */
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "syscall", VERBOSITY_INFO,
		    "r13=%i", cpu->cd.m88k.r[13]);
#if 0
		fatal("[ syscall %i(", cpu->cd.m88k.r[13]);
		m88k_cpu_functioncall_trace(cpu, 8);
		fatal(") ]\n");
#endif
		break;

	case MVMEPROM_VECTOR:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "MVMEPROM_VECTOR", VERBOSITY_INFO, "");
		break;

	default:
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "unknown vector",
		    vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START ? VERBOSITY_ERROR
		    : VERBOSITY_INFO, "0x%03x", vector);
	}

	/*
	 *  m88kexcdeliver (2026-09-05): the seven trap-like classes above are
	 *  DELIVERED (VBR + 8*vector, SXIP = the faulting instruction, SNIP = the
	 *  next one, destination register unchanged -- MC88100 UM 6.4.3/6.5/6.6/
	 *  6.8.3), like the four this fallback never covered.  Before, any of them
	 *  stopped EVERY guest CPU here: one divu by zero, in either mode, ended
	 *  the emulation (measured: regress/m88k_exc_probe.py rows div0/udiv0).
	 *  Pre-existing upstream code (this fallback is the 0.7.0 import),
	 *  surfaced by the 2026-09-05 retrospective of #380.  What still lands
	 *  here, by design: SFU1_PRECISE/IMPRECISE (114/115; row m88kexcsfu1 --
	 *  faithful delivery needs the rest of the SFU1 exception state, which
	 *  the fork does not write) and vectors 11..113/116..127 (117 vectors
	 *  with the two SFU1 ones), which no literal-constant raise site names
	 *  but a supervisor tb0/tb1/tcnd can name directly (row
	 *  m88kexctaildefault; the probe's resid50/sfu1h rows pin that they
	 *  STILL halt).
	 */
	if (vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START && !implemented) {
		debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "unimplemented",
		    VERBOSITY_ERROR, "vector=0x%03x pc=0x%08x",
			vector,
			(int)cpu->pc);
		for (int j = 0; j < cpu->machine->ncpus; ++j)
			cpu->machine->cpus[j]->running = false;
		m88k_pc_to_pointers(cpu);
		return;
	}

	/*  Stuff common for all exceptions:  */
	if (cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR] & M88K_PSR_SFRZ) {
		/*
		 *  Non-trap exceptions when the shadow freeze bit is already
		 *  set result in an Error exception:
		 */
		if (!is_trap) {
			vector = M88K_EXCEPTION_ERROR;
			fatal("[ SFRZ already set in PSR => ERROR ]\n");
		}

		update_shadow_regs = false;
	} else {
		/*  Freeze shadow registers, and save the PSR:  */
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_EPSR] = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR];
	}

	m88k_stcr(cpu, cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR]
	    | M88K_PSR_SFRZ	/*  Freeze shadow registers,          */
	    | M88K_PSR_IND	/*  disable interrupts,               */
	    | M88K_PSR_SFD1	/*  disable the floating point unit,  */
	    | M88K_PSR_MODE,	/*  and switch to supervisor mode.    */
	    M88K_CR_PSR, 0);

	if (update_shadow_regs) {
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SSBR] = 0;

		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SXIP] = cpu->pc | M88K_XIP_V;

		/*  SNIP is the address to return to, when executing rte:  */
		if (cpu->delay_slot) {
			if (vector == M88K_EXCEPTION_DATA_ACCESS) {
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.delay_target | M88K_NIP_V;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP]+4;
			} else if (vector == M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS) {
				/*  If we are in a delay slot, then pc is
				    something like 0xc6000 here (not 0xc5ffc).  */
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.delay_target | M88K_NIP_V;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = 0;
			} else {
				/*  Perhaps something like this could work:  */
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = (cpu->pc + 4) | M88K_NIP_V;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.delay_target | M88K_NIP_V;
			}
		} else {
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = (cpu->pc + 4) | M88K_NIP_V;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP]+4;
		}

		if (vector == M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS)
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SXIP] |= M88K_XIP_E;
	}

	cpu->pc = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_VBR] + 8 * vector;

	if (cpu->delay_slot)
		cpu->delay_slot = EXCEPTION_IN_DELAY_SLOT;
	else
		cpu->delay_slot = NOT_DELAYED;

	/*  Default to no memory transactions:  */
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT0] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD0] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA0] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT1] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD1] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA1] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT2] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD2] = 0;
	cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA2] = 0;

	/*  Vector-specific handling:  */
	if (vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START) {
		switch (vector) {

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_RESET:
			fatal("[ m88k_exception: reset ]\n");
			for (int j = 0; j < cpu->machine->ncpus; ++j)
				cpu->machine->cpus[j]->running = false;
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTERRUPT:
			/*  When returning with rte, we want to re-  */
			/*  execute the interrupted instruction:  */
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] -= 4;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] -= 4;
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS:
			/*  When returning with rte, we want to re-  */
			/*  execute the instruction in SXIP, not SNIP/SFIP,  */
			/*  (unless the exception was in a delay-slot):  */
			if (!(cpu->delay_slot & EXCEPTION_IN_DELAY_SLOT)) {
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = 0;
				cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = 0;
			}
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_DATA_ACCESS:
			/*  Update the memory transaction registers:  */
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT0] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmt[0];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD0] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmd[0];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA0] = cpu->cd.m88k.dma[0];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT1] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmt[1];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD1] = cpu->cd.m88k.dmd[1];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA1] = cpu->cd.m88k.dma[1];
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMT2] = 0;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMD2] = 0;
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_DMA2] = 0;
			m88k_memory_transaction_debug_dump(cpu, 0);
			m88k_memory_transaction_debug_dump(cpu, 1);
			break;

		case M88K_EXCEPTION_MISALIGNED_ACCESS:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_INTEGER_OVERFLOW:
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_ERROR:
			/*  m88kexcdeliver: OUTSIDE A DELAY SLOT the common path above
			    is already the architectural contract for these -- SXIP =
			    the faulting instruction, SNIP = the next one, SFIP = SNIP+4,
			    and rte resumes at SNIP (UM 6.4.3.1.4: "the processor
			    hardware does not use the SXIP on return from an exception"),
			    so the upstream doubt that sat here in an #if 0 ("should the
			    PC be backed up one step?") is answered NO: 6.5.x/6.8.3 say
			    the destination register is unchanged (6.6: and the carry
			    bit, for the overflow case), and a handler that wants
			    re-execution arranges SNIP/SFIP itself.  INSIDE a delay slot
			    the else-arm above ("Perhaps something like this could
			    work") is upstream's guess and the manual disagrees (Table
			    6-3: the shadows copy XIP/NIP/FIP, and UM 6.2 defines FIP as
			    the taken branch's target while the branch executes, so for
			    a fault in its delay slot NIP = target, FIP = target+4) --
			    pre-existing, now reachable by ordinary faults, row
			    m88kdslotshadow.
			    Without these labels the classes reached the default: below,
			    which stops the cpu -- the one-site fix was measured to do
			    exactly that; with them, nothing below 128 reaches that
			    default any more (it is unreachable code kept as the
			    tripwire for an eighth class).  ERROR arrives here by TWO
			    routes: the SFRZ re-route above (a fault inside a handler,
			    shadows deliberately frozen at the FIRST fault's values --
			    SXIP then names that first fault, not this one) and a
			    supervisor tb0/tb1/tcnd naming vector 10 directly (shadows
			    updated normally when that trap is taken UNFROZEN; inside a
			    handler it takes the is_trap exemption above and arrives
			    here with the shadows frozen).  Not modelled, disclosed: scoreboard
			    capture (the shadow-update path writes SSBR = 0; a frozen
			    SSBR keeps its old value) and fcr2/fcr4/fcr5 for the divide.  */
			break;

#if 0
		// TODO: Read up more about SFU1 exceptions and how the
		// control registers look when they happen.
		case M88K_EXCEPTION_SFU1_PRECISE:
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] = 0; //?
			cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] = 0;
			//cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SNIP] -= 4;
			//cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_SFIP] -= 4;
			break;
#endif

		default:debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_EXCEPTION, "m88k",
			    VERBOSITY_ERROR, "internal error");
			cpu->running = false;
		}
	}

	m88k_pc_to_pointers(cpu);
}

# Round #502 m88kexcdeliver -- the MC88100 model stopped EVERY guest CPU for seven trap-like exception classes; now it delivers them (VBR + 8*vector, shadows and PSR per the manual), and a 22-row detector pins the delivery

**2026-09-05.  HIGH.  `src/cpus/cpu_m88k.c` (`m88k_exception()`, 63+/12-), new `regress/m88k_exc_probe.py`, `regress/gate_m88k_rounding.sh` (gate 11).**
Artifacts: `regress/artifacts/m88kexcdeliver/` (both pass briefs, the pass-1 and pass-2 panel answers, the Opus and Fable pass-2 answers,
`PRETABLE_m88kexc.out`, three kill tables, the Opus pass-2 table, every probe output named below).

## The defect

`m88k_exception()` marked only RESET / INTERRUPT / INSTRUCTION_ACCESS / DATA_ACCESS `implemented`; MISALIGNED_ACCESS (4),
UNIMPLEMENTED_OPCODE (5), PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION (6), BOUNDS_CHECK_VIOLATION (7), ILLEGAL_INTEGER_DIVIDE (8), INTEGER_OVERFLOW (9) and
ERROR (10) printed a VERBOSITY_ERROR line and fell to the fallback `vector < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START && !implemented`, which
sets `running = false` on EVERY guest CPU: one `divu` by zero, in either mode, ended the emulation.  Real hardware delivers
VBR + 8*vector and the guest OS turns it into a signal.  Pre-existing upstream (the fallback is the 0.7.0 import; `git log -L`
returns only that commit); surfaced by the 2026-09-05 retrospective re-check of #380 (batch 2: GPT-6 Astra read-only, Fable 5.1
adjudicating).  Reachability, MEASURED rather than derived: the instruction raise sites (PRIVILEGE 10 literal sites, ILLEGAL_DIVIDE 4,
OVERFLOW 3, MISALIGNED 1, UNIMPLEMENTED 1) AND a supervisor `tb0/tb1/tcnd`, whose 9-bit field names any vector directly
(`m88k_exception(cpu, ic->arg[2], 1)`), so BOUNDS (7) and ERROR (10) -- which the filing called "latent, no raise site" -- ARE
reachable today (pass 1, Opus: supervisor `tb1 0,r3,7` halted HEAD).  The filing's sentence is corrected in place (ledger, OPEN LIST).

## Witness (rung 3) and fix

`regress/m88k_exc_probe.py`: cold-debugger rows on the COMMITTED, UNMODIFIED `testm88k` machine -- a guest program planted with `put w`,
registers seeded, `br .` at every vector entry, `breakpoint add <entry>`, `continue`, then `reg` / `reg 0,0`.  HEAD `83df95c`:
**0/9** (`probe2_head.out`), **0/10** (`probe10_head.out`), **3/22** with the final instrument (`probe_v3_head.out`: the 3 are the two
rows whose CORRECT answer is HALT and the pre-existing user vector 128); every trap-like class printed `unimplemented vector=` and the
machine stopped.  The fix: **9/9 -> 10/10 -> 22/22** (`probe2_fix.out`, `probe_v3_fix.out`, `probe_v3_fix_final.out` on the
rebuilt tree).

The fix is D1 of the six-member set -- DELIVER, at BOTH sites: `implemented = true` (at VERBOSITY_INFO, the level of the four
already-delivered classes) in the first switch, and a bare `case ... break` for the seven in the tail switch.  **The one-site form was
MEASURED (pass 1, Opus) to halt at the tail `default:` ("internal error") with pc/SXIP/PSR already correct -- only the
machine-still-running bit distinguished it from delivery**, which is why every fault row asserts the STOP channel before pc.  SFU1
(114/115) stays at the fallback by design (row `m88kexcsfu1`); vectors 11..113 and 116..127 (117 with the two SFU1 ones) stay at the
fallback and the detector's negative-control rows pin that they STILL halt.  D4 (make the tail default deliver everything) was named
by the pass-1 panel and not adopted -- bigger blast radius -- filed `m88kexctaildefault`.  Structural consequence, stated in the
comment: with `implemented` = {0..10} and tail labels for {0..10}, the tail `default:` is now UNREACHABLE for vectors < 128; it is
kept as the tripwire for an eighth class.

# Round #501 pcc2defaultkill -- the `default:` arm of DEVICE_ACCESS(pcc2) ended the host on any access to an uncased offset, reads included; now reads keep the served byte and writes are declined, one latched announce per offset

**2026-09-05.  HIGH, ranked first by the 2026-09-04 fix-review adjudication.  Product change: `src/devices/dev_pcc2.c`
-- the `exit(1)` replaced by a per-offset latched `fatal()` (`uint64_t warned_unimpl`, one bit per byte offset) that
says DECLINED for a write and SERVED 0x%02x for a read, then `break` to the handler's single `return 1`.  Detector:
`regress/pcc2_default_probe.py`, 46 rows (23 at pass 2; +13 by the pass-2 repair, +10 by the pass-3 repair, below), run by gate 14.  Witness: rung 3, measured before the edit.**

## The defect and its witness

Forty-three of the 0x40 byte offsets have no `case` (derived from `mvme_pcctworeg.h` against the 21 labels; two seats
re-derived it): eighteen NAMED registers the model does not implement (PSCALECNT, GPIO_ICR/PCR, SCCMOIACK, SCCTXIACK,
IEERR, IEICR, IEBERR, SCSIERR, the printer block, SPEED, PRTDATA), the twelve bytes INSIDE the four 32-bit
counter/compare words, and thirteen unnamed offsets.  Any access to one of them -- a READ included, although the
memcpy above the switch had already served it -- reached `default:` and `exit(1)`.

**The witness (`regress/artifacts/pcc2defaultkill/witness_20260905/`), measured on the committed build BEFORE the
edit: 7/13.**  A guest `st.b` to IEICR (0x2a) ends the host with exit status 1, the arm's own `pcc2: unimplemented`
line printed first (the arm was reached); a guest `ld.bu` there likewise -- the READ side kills too; IEBERR and the
in-word byte 0x05 and the alias 0x6a kill the same way.  Liveness (the probe's scratch round-trip) and
device-signature (CHIPID reads PCC2_ID 0x20) controls pass.  **The debugger's `put b` does NOT reach the arm** -- it
survives and prints nothing -- which the filing had called the cheapest witness (measured false; corrected).  The
witness script is the width probe's own `session()` helper: a first draft hand-rolled the pty wait, accepted a
STALE prompt, and read every kill as "survived" -- the carrier's rule about hand-rolled pty plumbing, re-learned.
The combined IEBERR/IEERR row measures IEBERR only (the exiting build dies at the first); IEERR's kill follows from
source (codex).  **13/13 on the fixed build.**

## The design (pass 1: nine seats, `_scratchpad/panel_20260905_021751`, converged)

READ: keep the byte the memcpy served and SAY it is served -- it is the register array's CURRENT byte (inside a running
COUNT word, the tick's; the pass-1 design said "default, not a computed value", corrected at pass 2), so this is not
the option set's member 4 and a bounded announce about it is not a wrong record.  WRITE:
member 3, DECLINE + latched announce -- NOT member 6 (backed accept), on three warrants the seats measured or read:
the file's own cased siblings contradict a blanket store (SCCERR is write-to-clear -- the board manual's SCLR bits

13-row witness at 13/13 under BOTH -- disposition-blind -- so the detector carries read-after-write rows in ONE

write-to-clear sibling `sccerr rdawr` as the control that reads 0x0 under either.

> ### OPEN -- filed 2026-09-05 (retrospective batch 7): dev_luna88k.c delivers an interrupt to a CPU that
> ### does not exist -- two ordinary guest stores on the one-cpu luna-88k kill the emulator process (MEASURED)
 *  (Used by both the stcr and rte instructions.)
 */
void m88k_stcr(struct cpu *cpu, uint32_t value, int cr, int rte)
{
	uint32_t old = cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr];

	switch (cr) {

	case M88K_CR_PSR:	/*  Processor Status Register  */
		if ((cpu->byte_order == EMUL_LITTLE_ENDIAN
		    && !(value & M88K_PSR_BO)) ||
		    (cpu->byte_order == EMUL_BIG_ENDIAN
		    && (value & M88K_PSR_BO))) {
			debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_CPU, "m88k", VERBOSITY_ERROR,
			    "stcr: TODO: attempt to change endianness by flipping"
			    " the endianness bit in the PSR. How should this"
			    " be handled? Aborting.");
			cpu->running = false;
			return;
		}

		if (!rte && old & M88K_PSR_MODE && !(value & M88K_PSR_MODE))
			debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_CPU, "m88k", VERBOSITY_WARNING,
			    "stcr: WARNING! the PSR_MODE bit is being"
			    " cleared; this should be done using the RTE "
			    "instruction only, according to the M88100 "
			    "manual! Continuing anyway.");

		if (value & M88K_PSR_MXM) {
			debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_CPU, "m88k", VERBOSITY_ERROR,
			    "stcr: TODO: MXM support");
			cpu->running = false;
			return;
		}

		if ((old & M88K_PSR_MODE) != (value & M88K_PSR_MODE))
			cpu->invalidate_translation_caches(
			    cpu, 0, INVALIDATE_ALL);

		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	case M88K_CR_EPSR:
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	case M88K_CR_SXIP:
	case M88K_CR_SNIP:
	case M88K_CR_SFIP:
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	case M88K_CR_SSBR:	/*  Shadow ScoreBoard Register  */
		if (value & 1)
			debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_CPU, "m88k", VERBOSITY_WARNING,
			    "stcr: WARNING! bit 0 non-zero when"
			    " writing to SSBR (?)");

		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	case M88K_CR_VBR:
		if (value & 0x00000fff)
			debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_CPU, "m88k", VERBOSITY_WARNING,
			    "stcr: WARNING! bits 0..11 non-zero when"
			    " writing to VBR (?)");

		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	case M88K_CR_DMT0:
	case M88K_CR_DMT1:
	case M88K_CR_DMT2:
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	case M88K_CR_SR0:	/*  Supervisor Storage Registers 0..3  */
	case M88K_CR_SR1:
	case M88K_CR_SR2:
	case M88K_CR_SR3:
		cpu->cd.m88k.cr[cr] = value;
		break;

	default:debugmsg_cpu(cpu, SUBSYS_CPU, "m88k", VERBOSITY_ERROR,
		    "stcr: UNIMPLEMENTED cr = 0x%02x (%s)",
		    cr, m88k_cr_name(cpu, cr));
		cpu->running = false;
		return;
	}
}

 *  m88k_fstcr():
 *
 *  Write to a floating-point control register.

void m88k_fstcr(struct cpu *cpu, uint32_t value, int fcr)
{
	switch (fcr) {

	case 63:
		/*  #298: the FPCR's RM field (bits 15:14) is now decoded by
		    the single-precision result stores, so a guest calling
		    fpsetround() -- which writes exactly this field -- is


/*
 *  tb0, tb1:  Trap on bit Clear/Set
 *
 *  arg[0] = bitmask to check (e.g. 0x00020000 for bit 17)
 *  arg[1] = pointer to register s1
 *  arg[2] = 9-bit vector number
 */
X(tb0)
{
	SYNCH_PC;

	if (!(cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR] & M88K_PSR_MODE)
	    && ic->arg[2] < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START) {
		m88k_exception(cpu, M88K_EXCEPTION_PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION, 0);
		return;
	}

	if (!(reg(ic->arg[1]) & ic->arg[0]))
		m88k_exception(cpu, ic->arg[2], 1);
}
X(tb1)
{
	SYNCH_PC;

	if (!(cpu->cd.m88k.cr[M88K_CR_PSR] & M88K_PSR_MODE)
	    && ic->arg[2] < M88K_EXCEPTION_USER_TRAPS_START) {
		m88k_exception(cpu, M88K_EXCEPTION_PRIVILEGE_VIOLATION, 0);
		return;
	}

	if (reg(ic->arg[1]) & ic->arg[0])
		m88k_exception(cpu, ic->arg[2], 1);
}


/*
 *  idle:
 *
 *  s:	ld    rX,rY,ofs
 *      bcnd  eq0,rX,s
 */
